messages.content: You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Which Python library provides LoRA support for Hugging Face models?
The PEFT library from Hugging Face provides LoraConfig and get_peft_model for adding LoRA adapters to transformers models.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Is LoRA good for teaching a model new facts?
LoRA works best for adapting style, format and task behavior. It can add some knowledge, but it is less reliable than retrieval for large or frequently changing facts.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Why is LoRA cheaper than full fine-tuning?
LoRA trains only a tiny fraction of the parameters, often under 1 percent. This cuts the memory needed for gradients and optimizer states and makes checkpoints very small.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What does lora_alpha control?
lora_alpha is a scaling factor. The adapter output is multiplied by alpha divided by r, which controls how strongly the adapter changes the base model's output.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Which layers are usually targeted by LoRA in a transformer?
The attention projections q_proj, k_proj, v_proj and o_proj are the most common targets. Many setups also add the MLP layers gate_proj, up_proj and down_proj.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is LoRA fine-tuning in one sentence?
LoRA fine-tuning adapts a large pretrained model by training small low-rank adapter matrices while the original weights stay frozen.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is a held-out evaluation set?
It is data kept out of training and used only to measure how well the model generalizes to examples it has not seen.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What learning rate is typical for LoRA?
LoRA commonly uses a higher learning rate than full fine-tuning, often around 1e-4 to 2e-4.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is the difference between LoRA and full fine-tuning?
Full fine-tuning updates every weight in the model. LoRA freezes the weights and trains small low-rank adapters, which uses far less memory and storage.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Why can a LoRA run overfit on a small dataset?
With few examples the adapter can memorize them. Lower the rank, add lora_dropout, train fewer epochs, and keep a held-out evaluation set.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What does print_trainable_parameters show?
It prints how many parameters are trainable, the total parameter count, and the trainable percentage. For LoRA the percentage is typically below 1 percent.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Does LoRA change the base model weights?
No. The base weights stay frozen during training. The adapter weights are saved separately and can be merged into the base model afterwards if you want.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
How can I load a saved LoRA adapter for inference?
Load the base model, then call PeftModel.from_pretrained(base_model, adapter_path). You can optionally call merge_and_unload() to fold the adapter into the base weights.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
How does LoRA modify a weight matrix?
For a frozen weight matrix W, LoRA learns two small matrices A and B and uses W + (alpha / r) * B @ A, where r is the rank. Only A and B are trained.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Answer in one word: what is the first letter of the word LoRA?
L
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is the LoRA dropout parameter?
lora_dropout applies dropout to the input of the adapter during training. It acts as regularization and helps reduce overfitting on small datasets.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is the rank r in LoRA?
The rank r is the inner dimension of the two adapter matrices. A smaller r means fewer trainable parameters; a larger r gives the adapter more capacity.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Does LoRA increase inference latency?
Not after merging. If the adapter is kept separate it adds a small extra computation per adapted layer.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What are typical values for LoRA rank?
Common ranks are 8, 16, 32 and 64. Ranks of 8 to 16 are a good starting point for many tasks.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
How large is a LoRA adapter checkpoint?
It is usually only a few megabytes to a few hundred megabytes, depending on rank and target modules, compared with gigabytes for a full model.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Can LoRA adapters be merged into the base model?
Yes. Because the update is B @ A scaled by alpha / r, it can be added to the original weight matrix. The merged model has no extra inference latency.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
How do I add LoRA to a model with PEFT?
Create a LoraConfig with r, lora_alpha, target_modules and task_type, then call get_peft_model(model, config). The returned model trains only the adapter weights.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is the purpose of lora_alpha divided by r?
It sets the scale of the adapter update. Keeping alpha proportional to r makes training behave similarly when you change the rank.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Can several LoRA adapters share one base model?
Yes. You can keep one frozen base model and load different adapters for different tasks, switching between them at inference time.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is a chat template?
A chat template is the rule that turns a list of role-tagged messages into the exact token format a model was trained on. Use tokenizer.apply_chat_template to apply it.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What does it mean to freeze a layer?
Freezing a layer sets requires_grad to False for its parameters, so gradient updates do not change them.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is an optimizer state and why does it matter for memory?
Optimizers like Adam keep extra tensors per trainable parameter, such as running averages. Training fewer parameters with LoRA greatly reduces this memory.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What is the task_type for causal language models in PEFT?
Use task_type='CAUSAL_LM' in LoraConfig for decoder-only causal language models.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Who introduced LoRA?
LoRA was introduced by Edward Hu and colleagues at Microsoft in the 2021 paper 'LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models'.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
Why should fine-tuning data match the model's chat template?
The model learned a specific format for system, user and assistant turns. Training data in a different format can degrade results, so use the model's own template.
You are a concise machine learning assistant.
What does gradient checkpointing do?
It saves memory by discarding some activations in the forward pass and recomputing them during the backward pass, at the cost of extra compute.
